title: I made a free Good Game Godot Workflow Plugin [feedback pls]
author: Plus_Scarcity6878
selftext:
I make small games in Godot as a hobby. For a while I used GSD and later buildomator (which is based on GSD and claims to use 92% less tokens) to let Claude Code build features. Both worked, but they wasted tokens due to growing, redundant documentation with to much prose, bad description, examples instead of clear facts. In an analysis for a game I used 150M tokens only for input with buildomator. That was 98% of my overall token usage.  
  
cc-godot is a good, leightweight plugin, that makes a good onboarding and project start with example-scenes, but does not give you a proper project managment with good documentation in my opinion. I try to fill that gap with gg-godot (free). You will have an onboarding where you share your vision, a roadmap separated into milestones executer and a blind QA, that is not primed into a specific direction.  
  
I worked for years in the pharma and later in the aerospace industry. In the first one I learned a good documentation practice and in the second one I learned proper project managment with milestons. This knowledge went into gg-godot together with my lessons learned as a hobby-godot-gamedev with a few released and not released projects.  
This is a human-in-the-loop plugin for building games in Godot with Claude Code. It aims to make game development more accessible and reliable.

![img](b4lvwbdj33yh1 "comparison of the plugins I mentioned")

please give me your honest feedback. And I would be happy to see games made with that plugin (and your lessons learned from it).  
  
*If you are an AI-Gamedev-Bro, with single-prompt games: stop it! Your tokens cost more then you will ever make AI does not excuse low-effort-slop.*
